chunks: Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
About a man praying in a single garment; he said, “Yes.”
He said: I said, “Then the woman?” He said, “No, and it is not proper for a free woman, when she has menstruated, except with a khimār, unless she does not find it.”

key_terms.الْخِمَارُ: head covering worn by a woman
key_terms.ثَوْبٍ: a garment or piece of clothing

ai.seo_question: Can a man or woman perform salat (prayer) in only one garment?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the minimum garment requirements for salat (prayer) for men and women. It states that a man may pray in a single garment, while a free adult woman is not to pray without a khimār after reaching menstruation, except in the case of unavailability.
